entries.zh: 井干；井栏，即井口的边沿（西语释作“井之暗口”）
entries.en: the dark lip/rim of a well (well curb/wellhead); the Chinese characters confirm poço “well”, not poco “little”
entries.notes: 西语栏 poço/poco 两读存疑，但汉字“井”确证其为“井”义，故取井口边沿为释。

entries.zh: 针黹；缝纫刺绣的活计（女红）
entries.notes: 第二字有“指/黹”两读之疑；按成词“针黹”（针线活计）为释。

entries.zh: 花；花纹，描画或绣作花纹图案的活计（西语释“绘花图案之工”）
entries.en: flowers; painted/flowery ornamental pattern-work (glossed in Spanish as work of painted figures)

entries.notes: 官话栏“qui tō here”难以解读（有 qui/gui 之疑），不影响西、汉、闽三栏“农＝labrador”的互证。

entries.zh: 佃；佃耕者，承种（他人）某块田地的人
entries.en: tenant; one who farms a given (leased) field (sementera)
entries.notes: 闽南音栏读出三个音节而汉字仅“佃”一字，两边不完全对应；释义以“佃＝佃耕者”为主。

entries.zh: 佃户；租种他人田地的农户
entries.en: tenant household; farming family tilling another's land

entries.zh: 佃主；田主，出租田地收租之人；西语栏与“农”同释为 labrador，所指略有出入
entries.en: landlord, lord of tenant farmers (owner who lets out the field); the compiler's Spanish gloss “labrador” rather reads it as the cultivator, so the sense wavers
entries.notes: “佃主”在汉语通常指田主/地主，而西语栏与“農”“農夫”同释 labrador，两者所指有出入，降为中置信。

entries.zh: 米石多；形容农人收稻甚丰，米粮数石有余（“石”为量米之器）
entries.en: a farmer who harvests much rice; his rice runs to many shí (picul) measures

entries.zh: 桃（桃子）；〔释义存疑：西语栏“compaños”疑为讹词，若作 con paños（以布帛）解，则此“桃”应即“挑”，指挑绣之工〕
entries.en: peach; [sense doubtful: Spanish “compaños” looks corrupt, perhaps “con paños” (with cloth), which would point to the embroidery sense “to pick up stitches” rather than “peach”]
entries.notes: “compaños”非通行西语词，疑为“con paños”之讹；若然首字当为“挑”（挑绣），与本页“桃[疑:桃/挑]花”条同例，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to cut/carve and polish (precious stones, jade)

entries.zh: 錾；錾刻，用錾子在器物上凿刻
entries.en: to chase with a chisel; to engrave on metal or other hard material

entries.zh: 錾花；在器物表面錾刻出花纹
entries.en: chasing of flower patterns; floral ornament engraved with a chisel

entries.zh: 打铜；锤打铜料制成器物（铜匠活）
entries.en: to beat/hammer copper into vessels; coppersmith's work

entries.notes: 西语栏“sedellas comtable”疑有讹误，汉字首字有“勢/費”两读之疑，闽南音写亦无法对应确定成词，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 刻、剥；雕镂木材并剥去其皮，如雕花匠做工
entries.en: to carve and strip wood, working like a wood-carver (entallador)

entries.zh: 挑花（原稿写作“桃”，疑为“挑”）；用针挑绣出花纹
entries.en: fancy floral needlework worked with the needle; the first character is written “peach” but is probably the one for “to pick up (stitches)”
entries.notes: 首字有“桃/挑”两读之疑；按“挑花”（针挑刺绣）为释，并与第10条互参。

entries.zh: 鞋云头；鞋头上的云朵形绣饰，即绣制鞋尖的云头花
entries.en: cloud-shaped embroidered toe-cap of a shoe; embroidery on the shoe tip
entries.notes: 西语“capas”与汉字“鞋”不尽吻合，且此条有音号污损难辨（T99），降为低置信；“鞋云头＝鞋头云形绣饰”则三栏互证尚清晰。

entries.zh: 凿；用凿子的尖刃凿打（“拳头”二字疑讹，或为“榫头”，即凿榫头之木工）
entries.en: to chisel, working with the point of a chisel; the following compound (“fist”) is doubtful, possibly a miswriting of “mortise/tenon-head”
entries.notes: 此条有音号污损难辨（T99）；“拳头”于“凿”义下难解，疑为“榫头”之讹，语义存疑。
